about: The airport belongs to the Severstal aviation company. Runway length 2,500 m, terminal capacity 120 passengers per hour.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Station forecourt: up to 90 minutes free; if a flight is delayed, a repeat entry for 90 minutes is free. Over 90 minutes, a fee of 1,000 ₽ for each day. Paid round-the-clock car park: 350 ₽ per day. Phone (8202) 675-217.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: ON PASS business lounge on Level 1 in the left part of the building, 14 seats. Admits passengers with ON PASS access and Business fare passengers after check-in and security. Opening hours follow the airport schedule. Reception +7 (909) 523-92-09.

sleep.title: Where to sleep
sleep.text: Sky-Park 3* hotel next to the airport: 62 rooms, restaurant on Level 1, Wi‑Fi. Booking +7 (8202) 67-52-64.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: Mother and child room on Level 1 in the domestic waiting hall. For departing passengers with children under 7, disabled children and pregnant women. Free of charge. Call a passenger service staff member or go to the check-in counter.
